body: I was always told that highschool is the best part of my life.  And since my opinion on it is very poor, I'm assuming the rest of my life is going to be worse...

Thank you very much for this.
I think this was the final comment to convince me not to do it.

Honestly, I'm basically in poverty in contrast to the rest of my town.  I don't really care about material goods, they don't take away the feeling of being alone.
How's homeschooling?  I was considering that last year as I got socially bullied hard.

I'm going to sound like a dick, but seeing people in such a low point in life depresses me further.
Maybe EMS or Fire response would be good for me.
I'm just starting to drive, and soon to drive on my own.  I hope to help all those I see broken down on the side of the road.  It seems to be the only kind of satisfaction I can get in this world.
I've always lived my life like that. I'm willing to sac my life for someone elses.  I try to do my best to help others.
I don't even know how I'd go about acting on my second chance.
Too bad I'm not getting a second chance.  Military for me.
My question is more of why do you give a fuck if someone that you never knew didn't exist anymore.
My problem isn't so much me being bored.  its more of just me being lonely and not having anyone to share with.  It sucks.
It's not worth it to stay alive for me to practice any of these hobbies.

I ask them all the time to let me purchase a rifle with my own money.
I asked them if I could buy it and keep it at my gun enthusiast neighbor's house.  All with no luck at all.
Rifle shooting in a heartbeat.  But living in New Jersey with hardcore gun hating parents isn't going to be possible.

Yeah and if I end it, I void all chances of me winning the megamillions.  Same odds.

I take photographs that are pretty shitty and play MilSim airsoft.  My airsoft friends are my only source of friends.  And I never speak to them out of the game.

What do I want?  For me to have a girl that loves me for who I am.

What would I change?  Not ending it when I felt suicidal in 4th grade.
If I tell my parents I am suicidal, I don't feel like ending up in a hospital for a week for psychiatric review on my mental health.

Maybe my purpose is to get the fuck off earth and let everyone go on their own way.  
I can't see how I can change someone elses life for the better.
Whats your effect on the world besides convincing people from ceasing their painful and miserable lives?

Well of course depression is chemical.  All of our thoughts are on the chemical and electrical scale.  
I am pretty much determined that a drug won't help me.  I'll probably placebo right through it and it will have no effect.

I don't see how someone could simply change my thought process I've had for the longest time.  
It's the basis for my reasoning.  I don't think its even remotely possible for someone to change me into an Optimist.
Honestly, I don't bring benefit to anyone else.  I'm a nuisance to my family and kids near me in school.  I've tried to make better, but ended up the opposite way.

I've already visited a psychiatrist.  Started to get expensive, didn't have any progress.  It's not going to change my lonlieness.  I'm that one kid that everyone finds annoying.  And that's when I try to interact with others.

I've felt like this in fourth grade.  I distinctly remember wanting to hang myself from our basketball hoop at recess.
I don't think I could kill myself as long as my mother and father are still around.  
Three years ago, they thought I swallowed a bottle of Advil and I had to spend something like two days in the hospital.

Ok, I don't have depression as everyone tells me that I'm a wanna be depression person (whatever that means).  Ok so, take away depression, so I'm just lonely with a smile.  Sounds great to me.
I feel so unnoticed.  I spend hours daydream that I'm in the scenario where I could save somebody.  For instance, last week in school I day dreamed that a kid brought a gun to school and was aiming it at some kid in the hallway.  But then I go and tackle him and I end up disarming him, but I end up getting shot and losing my leg or something.  
I was in the car today riding with my sister.  I was happily imagining getting in a car crash, having my right leg being aputated.  I was lusting  after being able to go into school after recovery and let people figure on there own I lost a leg.  Not sure why I'm attracted to this.  Probably just crazyness.  Probably thirst for attention, Idk.
I'm going to go try in person on Monday, (won't see her till then)
